banner.title: Shakespeare Central Apartment
banner.subtitle: Welcome to
banner.body: A modern and elegant apartment located right in the heart of Craiova, just a few steps away from the most important tourist attractions, restaurants, and shops. This apartment is perfect for those who want to explore the city and enjoy everything it has to offer.

benefit1.title: Central Location
benefit1.description: Just a few steps from major attractions, restaurants, and public transport.

benefit2.title: Comfort & Style
benefit2.description: Modern, spacious design equipped with everything you need for a pleasant stay.

benefit3.title: Fast Wi-Fi
benefit3.description: Free high-speed internet, ideal for work or relaxation.

placesToVisit.subtitle: Discover Craiova
placesToVisit.title: Places to visit
placesToVisit.description: Craiova is a city rich in history, culture, and natural beauty. Here are some of the most important places you shouldn't miss during your visit.

theApartment.subtitle: The Apartment
theApartment.title: Your home away from home
theApartment.description: Shakespeare Central Apartment offers you the privacy and comfort of a home, right in the center of the city.
